Change c0282. Location: 1818 Vol. II, Ch. VII; 1831 Ch. XV.

Context before (unchanged): I often referred the several situations, as their similarity struck me, to my own.

1818 text: Like Adam, I was created apparently united by no link to any other being in existence; but his state was far different from mine in every other respect. He had come forth from the hands of God a perfect creature, happy and prosperous, guarded by the especial care of his Creator; he was allowed to converse with, and acquire knowledge from beings of a superior nature: but I was wretched, helpless, and alone.

1831 text: Like Adam, I was apparently united by no link to any other being in existence; but his state was far different from mine in every other respect. He had come forth from the hands of God a perfect creature, happy and prosperous, guarded by the especial care of his Creator; he was allowed to converse with, and acquire knowledge from, beings of a superior nature: but I was wretched, helpless, and alone.

Diff: Like Adam, I was [-created-] apparently united by no link to any other being in existence; but his state was far different from mine in every other respect. He had come forth from the hands of God a perfect creature, happy and prosperous, guarded by the especial care of his Creator; he was allowed to converse with, and acquire knowledge from {+,+} beings of a superior nature: but I was wretched, helpless, and alone.

Context after (unchanged): Many times I considered Satan as the fitter emblem of my condition; for often, like him, when I viewed the bliss of my protectors, the bitter gall of envy rose within me.

result.rationale: Deletion of 'created' weakens the creation-as-origin emphasis, and the added comma in 'acquire knowledge from, beings' is punctuation only. Small stylistic tightening; the creature's loneliness and the Adam parallel stay intact.
